newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan ends up at year-high against US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan ends up at year-high against US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan closed up at a year-high of 8.3036 on Thursday from Wednesday's 8.3042 against the U.S. dollar on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market, traders said.
It was the fourth day in a row that the yuan ended at a year-high.
The yuan opened up at an intra-day low of 8.3040 and moved up steadily to consolidate around 8.3035 for most of the session, hitting a high of 8.3031.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3036, traders said.
Dealers said the yuan jumped to a higher level of 8.3040 today, continuing its uptrend on strong pro-yuan sentiment.
"More buying emerged to push the yuan up," said one dealer, "The local unit seems on its way to the topside of 8.3000."
"The central bank reduced its depression of the yuan, which encouraged its rise in the past few days," another dealer said.
Dealers expect the yuan to move in a range of 8.3030 and 8.3040 on Friday.
The yuan closed down at 7.5805 from 7.5480 against 100 Japanese yen and down at an intra-day low of 1.0745 against the Hong Kong dollar.
